stayType: Holiday park with caravans and touring pitches
accommodation: Caravans in several grades (Bronze to Emerald), including accessible caravans and Beach Haven caravans (Diamond with private hot tubs); electric, basic and super touring and camping pitches.
suitableFor: Families, campers and tourers, dog owners (selected caravans), wheelchair users (adapted caravans).
parking: Beach Haven caravans include parking for two cars; 24 EV chargers in main car park and 2 at Beach Haven (own Type 2 cable needed).
dogs: Welcome in selected caravans and most outdoor areas; not in indoor pool, arcade, cinema or shop.
beachAccess: Woodland path to the beach: 15-20 minutes to Combesgate beach, 25-30 minutes to Woolacombe beach; about 5-8 minutes by car.
confirmedFeatures: indoor heated pool with flumes, outdoor heated pool and slides, Wavesurfer, climbing wall, cinema, live shows, arcade, Bar 51 and other bars, convenience store, EV charging
overview: Twitchen House sits between Mortehoe and Woolacombe in North Devon, run by Woolacombe Holiday Parks. It has graded caravans, a quieter sea-view Beach Haven area and touring pitches, with indoor and outdoor pools and a Wavesurfer. A woodland path reaches Combesgate in 15-20 minutes and Woolacombe beach in under half an hour.
surfTripFit: Touring pitches and walkable access to Combesgate and Woolacombe make it a practical surf base, though no board storage or outdoor showers are stated.
gaps: Board/wetsuit storage not stated. Page gives slightly inconsistent drive times.
